In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], a '''3D-4X administrative droid''' served in [[Government House (Worlport)|Government House]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. When word reached the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] were approaching, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] relayed the news to [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]].
